title: Loyalty of the affine line in motivic homotopy theory
summary: We show that integers act invertibly on a derived scheme $S$ if and only if they act invertibly on the reduced motivic suspension spectrum of the affine line in $\mathrm{MS}_S$. As a consequence, over regular locally noetherian schemes and derived schemes on which some nonzero integer acts as zero, the motivic sphere spectrum is $\mathbf{A}^1$-invariant after inverting primes that are not invertible in the base scheme. In particular, over regular locally noetherian $\mathbf{Q}$-schemes, the motivic sphere spectrum is $\mathbf{A}^1$-invariant.
